profile.headline: AI-Amplified Software Engineer | Product-Minded Frontend & Full-Stack Development | React, TypeScript, Accessibility & Design Systems
profile.summary:
I’m an AI-amplified software engineer with 4+ years of experience building accessible, production-grade applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend architecture.
 
My strongest lane is frontend-leaning full-stack delivery: turning complex product workflows into reliable user experiences across UI, API integration, validation, testing, and release readiness. I’ve built in healthcare technology environments where UX, reliability, compliance-adjacent thinking, and cross-functional delivery matter.
 
At Phreesia, I shipped accessible React/TypeScript product experiences for a healthcare platform that enabled more than 180M patient visits in 2025 and supported 4,500+ healthcare services clients. I worked closely with product, design, backend engineering, and QA to translate ambiguous requirements into production-ready patient and provider workflows.
 
I also use AI workflows intentionally across technical discovery, debugging, test planning, implementation planning, and documentation. The point is not to outsource judgment, it’s to move faster, explore more edge cases, and raise the quality bar while still validating through code review, local testing, and product context.
 
I’m currently looking for software engineering roles where React, TypeScript, product thinking, accessibility, design systems, testing, and AI-amplified delivery are valued.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-founded/built a commercial AI application that helps small businesses evaluate workflow opportunities, identify practical AI use cases, and develop implementation plans.

- Built the full-stack application using React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, and Docker, with Stripe-based paid-product fulfillment and protected administrative workflows.

- Implemented real-time LLM features through a provider-agnostic architecture with deterministic fallbacks, validation, testing, model metadata, bounded revision loops, and human approval. 

- Used an agentic software-development lifecycle in which coding agents work from governed product and architecture specifications, implement and test bounded work, and maintain verification and traceability while humans retain consequential product, architecture, and launch decisions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built accessible, production-grade React/TypeScript product experiences for patient- and provider-facing healthcare workflows.

- Delivered frontend-leaning full-stack features across UI workflows, API integration, validation logic, and release testing.

- Developed reusable, design-system-aligned components with emphasis on accessibility, responsiveness, usability, and long-term maintainability.

- Partnered with product, design, backend engineering, and QA to translate ambiguous requirements into production-ready patient and provider workflows.

- Created and maintained Playwright end-to-end tests to reduce regression risk, strengthen release confidence, and support faster iteration.

- Used AI workflows to accelerate technical discovery, debugging, test planning, and implementation while validating through code review, local testing, and product context.

positions.title: Hydraulic Engineer
positions.description:
- Reviewed permit-related construction and planning materials for water-resource projects within Indiana DNR’s Division of Water permitting environment.

- Analyzed technical datasets, flood records, construction plans, and field conditions to support engineering recommendations.

- Evaluated regulatory, hydraulic, environmental, and permitting constraints to produce clear, defensible project guidance.

- Built early-career judgment in systems thinking, risk assessment, technical documentation, and compliance-adjacent decision-making.

projects.title: Chapter Chat
projects.description:
- Full-featured mobile social reading app built with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Jest, and React Native Testing Library.

- Built 10+ product areas including book tracking, reading sessions, analytics, social activity, clubs, notifications, profiles, search, reminders, and an iOS widget. Integrated Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, and Storage with generated database types for end-to-end type safety across authentication, books, stats, activity, clubs, follows, and notifications.

- Implemented product-grade UX patterns including optimistic social actions, light/dark theme tokens, configurable reminders, reading streaks, charts, secure session storage, and a native iOS widget/Live Activity module.
